key_constitutional_quirks: Reform won 45 of 49 seats (91.8%) — largest mandate in the cohort.
Council under statutory Best Value Direction with government Commissioners (Sept 2022 onwards, extended to 30 April 2028) — every major Cabinet decision requires Commissioner non-objection.

Commissioners: Gavin Jones CBE (Lead), Denise Murray (Finance), Dr Dave Smith (MD). Sixth Commissioners' report (27 Jan 2026) noted 'smooth transition to new leadership' but council is 'not yet meeting its Best Value Duty'.
LGR confirmed — abolition April 2028, merges with Basildon into South West Essex unitary. Govt has committed to repay £200M of Thurrock debt in 2026/27.
Working under £638M capitalisation direction (was £691M) + £41M three-year savings target. EFS requested every year since 2022/23.

Outside body appointments — prioritise the SRA-paying bodies (Fire / Pension / Combined Authority / PCP) since these reward members beyond the council's own allowances pot.
